modelOverview: The Royal Oak Double Balance Wheel Openworked 41mm strips the dial away to reveal Audemars Piguet's in-house Calibre 3132, whose patented dual balance-wheel architecture is displayed front and centre through the skeletonised movement. It marries the iconic octagonal 'Tapisserie'-less openworked aesthetic with the Royal Oak's integrated case and bracelet, offered across steel and precious-metal executions. Each piece pairs the collection's 1972 Gerald Genta design language with a modern feat of horological transparency.
